Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență

Empowering our Clients with People-Driven Digital Innovation Across Europe 
 We are a Group managing digital IT services and solutions , driven by people, innovation, agility, and deep
 industry insight. We are working with the largest private and public institutions to deliver IT services and solutions.
 Being an entrepreneurial digital services group with a Human-Sized Tech Company, we are built by passionate
 experts and led by seasoned leaders in IT and digital transformation.
 Responsibilities: 
  Plan, develop and implement projects or features of large-scale projects, as part of the development team
  Develop solutions to improve performance and scalability of systems
  Assisting in Production issues
  Share knowledge about your area of expertise, best practices and provide functional support
 What we are looking for: 
 Experience: 
  Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in Java technologies, with expertise in Backend design & development
 Backend
  Java Standard Edition (for legacy apps: 5-8; for evolutions: 17 or newer)
  Spring Boot
  Relational database: Oracle DB / PostgreSQL
  Web services: REST API
  Design patterns, SOLID principles
  GIT (GitFlow, SemVer), Maven, CI/CD pipeline (Jenkins/Ansible/Gitlab CI)
  Hexagonal architecture
  Spring Batch
  Microservices
  Unit & integration testing
 Other: 
  Quality gate: SonarQube
  Tools: Postman, SoapUI, Bruno
  Linux: Basic knowledge (regular user & root)
  Cloud: Docker, Kubernetes, Cloud native concepts
  Agile (Scrum, SAFE)
 Although not required, would be considered a plus if you have knowledge about:
  API testing (Karate)
  Frontend: React/Angular/JSP
  SOAP API
  Autosys (for Batches)
 We are also interested in: 
  Language skills:
  French - basic conversational skills and the ability to understand technical documentation. A willingness and motivation to continuously improve language proficiency is expected. 
  English- Able to communicate effectively in conversations and understand technical documentation
  Attention to details, analytical skills
  Good communication skills
  Team player mentality: ability and willingness to collaborate and support in a global team
  Self-driven, proactive, suggests ideas, has initiative, positive mindset
  Ability to work autonomously, self-learner
 Job Benefits 
 We offer 
  Competitive salary and the opportunity to have a meaningful job where you can make a difference
  The chance to continuously evolve as a professional
  Medical insurance & Meal tickets. Variety of training opportunities
 Join Us at EASYDO 
 With a team of 250 dedicated professionals, we combine technological excellence with a people-first culture. We
 believe in empowering talent, nurturing careers, and building long-term trust with our clients and our teams
